description: This file defines constants and runtime checks related to AWS services, specifically DynamoDB and SQS, for testing purposes within the Orleans AWSUtils project. It includes lazy evaluation to determine DynamoDB availability by trying to initialize a test DynamoDB table.

classes.name: AWSTestConstants
classes.description: Contains constants and lazy evaluators to check AWS DynamoDB and SQS service availability for testing purposes.

methods.name: AWSTestConstants._isDynamoDbAvailable
methods.description: Lazy initializer that attempts to connect and initialize a DynamoDB table to determine if DynamoDB is available.
